method.method_draft: Model the situation with variables. Let S be the sandwich price and J be the juice price. From the problem/image, form the equations S + J = 12 and S + 2J = 14. Subtract the first equation from the second, or equivalently substitute S = 12 - J into the second: 12 - J + 2J = 14, so J = 2. Therefore one juice costs 2 Euros.
